case_number: 2024 INSC 172; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO(S). OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP(Crl.) No(s). 9591 of 2022)
summary: Suicide note as sole basis for abetment charge; insufficient evidence of instigation under Section 306 IPC; SC/ST Act prosecution invalid without caste-based motive; harassment allegations not meeting abetment standard; quashing of proceedings warranted due to absence of essential ingredients; Section 482 CrPC relief granted.
legal_provisions_cited: Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 s.3(2)(v)
Masumsha Hasanasha Musalman v. State of Maharashtra
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; criminal proceedings quashed for lack of prima facie evidence.
